findings.evidence: Page 5: "Full terms: github.com/zhiqitao/from-token-to-fleet/blob/27f4cd5/LICENSE" and "(raw file: raw.githubusercontent.com/zhiqitao/from-token-to-fleet/27f4cd5/LICENSE)". The text also states "the LICENSE file at the pinned commit below governs wherever the two differ" and "the link above resolves that commit's LICENSE file directly".
findings.issue: The bare-hostname URL "github.com/zhiqitao/..." is not a resolvable hyperlink form (no scheme); the book elsewhere gives fully qualified raw.githubusercontent.com URLs for the same resource, so the primary license pointer is inconsistent in form with the book's own citation convention. More substantively, the book asserts that the LICENSE file 'is the authoritative statement of rights' and that 'the link above resolves that commit's LICENSE file directly' — but the LICENSE text itself is never reproduced in the book, so a buyer who cannot reach the repository has no operative license terms in the artifact they purchased.
findings.fix_instruction: Render the license pointer as a full https:// URL and, for a print/PDF artifact that must stand alone, reproduce the operative LICENSE text in an appendix or at minimum reproduce its two operative bullets plus the SPDX identifier verbatim, with a note that the repository file governs if they differ.

findings.evidence: Page 5: "SPDX identifier: LicenseRef-ZhiqiResearch-FromTokenToFleet-1.0." and "Edition source revision. This edition is built from commit 27f4cd571d53ecb2ac549d5825a77c87f8736ad3 (short 27f4cd5)". The Preface (p. 18) repeats: "build identifier v20260913 is the content edition".
findings.issue: The copyright page pairs a custom LicenseRef SPDX identifier with a commit hash as the edition's source revision, but the SPDX identifier contains no reference to the revision, and the commit hash cannot be verified from the artifact (no signature, no checksum of the LICENSE file, no embedded copy). The book repeatedly leans on 'the pinned commit' as an authenticity anchor (pp. 5, 12, 18) but provides no verifiable binding between the stated commit and the shipped PDF — the build identifier v20260913 likewise does not appear in the copyright page, only in the Preface (p. 18) and in the addenda revisions.
findings.fix_instruction: Add the build identifier (v20260913) and the evidence cutoff (2026-08-30) to the copyright page so the artifact is self-identifying, and either include a SHA-256 of the LICENSE file at the pinned commit or state plainly that the commit hash is an unverified pointer that a reader must resolve themselves.

findings.evidence: List of Figures (pp. 8–10) entries: '1.1 The KV cache: every token adds one K/V per layer per head . . . 9'; '1.2 How a token travels: text → tokenizer → IDs → embedding → attention → KV cache . . . 10'; '2.1 The canonical end-to-end inference pipeline . . . 20'; '2.2 Prefill and decode split by the roofline ridge . . . 27'; '3.1 Corruption and learned reverse generation . . . 37'; '3.2 Dependency order and cache lifetime . . . 38'; '3.3 Wan2.2 A14B selects experts as the denoising schedule progresses . . . 48'; '3.4 Dense vs MoE parameter allocation and KV cache behavior . . . 51'; '4.1 Six workload dimensions ... . . . 87'... Actual figure locations from the PDF: Fig 1.1 on PDF p. 29 (printed p. 9 per the running-head offset of 20 for pages before the sampled ones — the sampled page 57 shows running head '38' and PDF page 153 shows '134', an offset of 19), Fig 2.1 on PDF p. 40 (printed 20 → offset 20), Fig 2.2 on PDF p. 47 (printed 27 → offset 20), Fig 3.1 on PDF p. 57 (printed 37 → offset 20), Fig 3.2 on PDF p. 58 (printed 38 → offset 20), Fig 3.3 on PDF p. 68 (printed 48 → offset 20), Fig 3.4 on PDF p. 71 (printed 51 → offset 20), Fig 4.1 on PDF p. 107 (printed 87 → offset 20).
findings.issue: The List of Figures' page numbers are correct and consistent (all figures land at printed page = PDF page − 20 for pp. 29–107), but the printed running heads on the sampled page images (PDF p. 57 → '38'; PDF p. 153 → '134') show an offset of 19, not 20 — i.e. the running-head folios on two sampled interior pages are one less than the offset that reproduces every List-of-Figures entry. One of the two conventions is wrong: either the running-head folio is mis-set on those pages (and on every page between), or the List of Figures' page numbers are off by one for a span of pages. Since the sampled pages are exactly the ones where Fig 3.2 (printed 38) and Fig 7.2 (printed 134) appear — and both are listed at those page numbers in the List of Figures — the List of Figures agrees with the running heads for those two figures, meaning the running head is the reliable one and the offset is not uniform across the document (i.e. the front matter length changed between p. 20 and p. 57, or the running-head folio has a defect on the sampled pages).
findings.fix_instruction: Audit the printed folio against the List of Figures and the Contents for a continuous run of pages (especially the transitions at PDF pp. 21–22 and 40–47), correct whichever is mis-set, and confirm the Contents' chapter start pages (1, 2, 15, 35, 55, 56, 92, 109, 122, 123, 154, 176, 194, 207, 226, 227, 245, 254, 265, 285, 311, 312, 338, 353, 377, 391, 397, 398, 410, 417, 432, 447, 467, 500, 505, 508, 516) all resolve to the printed folios.

findings.evidence: Page 5: "Technical disclaimer. This book describes an evolving field. ... Every quantitative value here carries an explicit evidence label — a dated measurement, a figure derived from cited inputs, an illustrative assumption, or a stated hypothesis; the three label axes behind those labels are defined in the Preface, and the full label set in the Sources, Method, and Reproducibility chapter."
findings.issue: The copyright page enumerates four kinds of evidence ('a dated measurement, a figure derived from cited inputs, an illustrative assumption, or a stated hypothesis') while the Preface defines five Axis-2 epistemic values (FACT, DERIVED, ASSUMPTION, HYPOTHESIS, UNRESOLVED) and five Axis-3 measurement statuses (ANALYTICAL, SCENARIO-DERIVED, MODELED, MEASURED, UNMEASURED). The enumeration omits FACT and UNRESOLVED — both of which the body uses extensively ([1P][FACT] appears on pp. 23, 43, 93, 137; [UNRESOLVED] on pp. 63, 69, 109, 116). So the front-matter description of the label system does not enumerate the labels the book actually applies, and the earlier stated count ('three label axes') does not match the Preface's own 'two label axes, plus an optional third' framing (p. 16).
findings.fix_instruction: Make the copyright page's enumeration match the Preface's label set (five Axis-2 values plus the five Axis-3 statuses), or state that the list is illustrative rather than exhaustive, so a buyer reading only the copyright page is not told the label system is smaller than it is.

findings.evidence: List of Figures (p. 8): '1 The architect's decision loop — the book's spine . . . x'; '2 Reading the book two ways . . . xi'. Page 14 (Fig 1): 'figure 1: The architect's decision loop — the book's spine.' Page 15 (Fig 2): 'figure 2: Reading the book two ways.'
findings.issue: The two front-matter figures are numbered '1' and '2' in the List of Figures, while every chapter figure is numbered by chapter ('1.1', '2.1', ..., 'A.1'). The Preface's own text (p. 14) writes 'the same six questions recur in the same order as the short prompts in Fig. 2' — so the figures are cited as 'Fig. 2' (bare number) in the body, which collides with the chapter-figure numbering: 'Fig 2.1' (the canonical end-to-end inference pipeline, Ch. 2) and 'Fig 2.2' (the roofline) both begin with '2'. A reader encountering 'Fig. 2' has three candidates: the front-matter 'figure 2' (Reading the book two ways), 'Fig 2.1' or 'Fig 2.2'. Ch. 2's own text (p. 49) uses 'Fig 2.1' with the chapter prefix, so the front-matter figures are the ambiguous ones.
findings.fix_instruction: Renumber the two front-matter figures with a distinct prefix (e.g. 'P.1' and 'P.2' for Preface, or 'F.1'/'F.2') in the List of Figures, the figures themselves and every body citation ('Fig. 2' on p. 14), so 'Fig. 2' can never be confused with Ch. 2's figures.

findings.evidence: Page 5: "Applicable terms and edition. The SPDX identifier above names the exact license version this edition is published under, and the commit above is the immutable source revision that carries it; together they are the authoritative reference, so a buyer can confirm the exact text rather than infer it from the published form."
findings.issue: The sentence claims the SPDX identifier plus the commit 'are the authoritative reference, so a buyer can confirm the exact text rather than infer it from the published form' — but the published form (the two plain-language bullets) explicitly says it is 'not operative in [its] own right' and that the LICENSE file governs. So the artifact asserts that a buyer can confirm 'the exact text' of the license, while simultaneously stating that the exact text is not reproduced and is not operative. The claim of verifiability therefore rests entirely on the reader being able to reach a GitHub URL in a purchased PDF — with no offline fallback, no printed short-form identifier of the license's operative clauses, and no checksum.
findings.fix_instruction: Reword the 'Applicable terms and edition' paragraph so it does not claim the reader can confirm the exact text from the identifier alone: state that the identifier and commit identify the license version for online verification, and note that the operative terms are not reproduced in this artifact.

findings.evidence: p.5: 'Every quantitative value here carries an explicit evidence label — a dated measurement, a figure derived from cited inputs, an illustrative assumption, or a stated hypothesis; the three label axes behind those labels are defined in the Preface'; Preface p.16: 'The four terms above are not four parallel registers. Each names its axis'
findings.issue: The copyright page summarizes the evidence system as one flat four-way choice of label kinds, but the Preface's operative system assigns each claim a two-axis pair (provenance + epistemic) with an optional third axis. The four listed kinds span the axes unevenly (no pure Axis-1 provenance item appears; 'an illustrative assumption' merges Axes 1 and 2), so the summary reintroduces the 'four parallel registers' reading the Preface explicitly rules out.
findings.fix_instruction: Rewrite the sentence to name the three axes (where the number came from / what was done to it / measurement status) instead of enumerating four label kinds, or mirror the Preface panel's term-to-axis mapping verbatim.

findings.evidence: 'The full text of the license, including the redistribution restrictions and the channel-specific terms (e.g. Amazon KDP), is the LICENSE file in the repository, which is the authoritative statement of rights for this work.
